cases.name: filter-slice-ends-before-it-starts
cases.description: slice:from,to with from past to empties the column

cases.name: filter-group-size-is-not-a-number
cases.description: a group size the engine cannot use, so the value comes out ungrouped

cases.name: filter-compact-base-out-of-range
cases.description: a base outside 2..36 leaves the number unchanged

cases.name: filter-argument-on-a-filter-that-reads-none
cases.description: trim takes no argument, so anything after the colon reaches nothing

cases.name: filter-replace-with-nothing-to-look-for
cases.description: replace with no from= changes nothing at all

cases.name: json-filter-on-a-list-without-its-separator
cases.description: | json on a repeat= list prints the whole joined cell as ONE string — valid JSON, and almost never what was meant. The warning names the separator to write.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="L"><gen type="text" value="Milk,Soy" repeat="0..2" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{L | json}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: json-filter-splitting-on-the-wrong-separator
cases.description: | json:, on a list joined with ; finds no comma and prints a one-element array.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="L"><gen type="text" value="Milk,Soy" repeat="0..2" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{L | json:,}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: json-filter-on-a-pool-list-read-by-an-each-line
cases.description: The same mistake on a list FIELD of a pool, read as Doctors.languages on a line walking Doctors.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="2"><sequence name="id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="name"><gen type="text" value="Cardiology,Neurology"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Doctors" count="3"><sequence name="last"><gen type="text" value="Adams,Baker"/></sequence><sequence name="dept"><gen type="pool" value="Depts"/></sequence><sequence name="languages"><gen type="text" value="English,Spanish" repeat="1..2" separator=";"/></sequence></pool></env><block><line each="Doctors"><data>${{Doctors.last | json}}: ${{Doctors.languages | json}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: json-filter-with-a-bare-colon
cases.description: json: with nothing after the colon names no separator: write | json for one value or | json:; for a list.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="L"><gen type="text" value="Milk,Soy" repeat="0..2" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{L | json:}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: json-filter-on-the-list-an-each-line-walks
cases.description: On a line walking a list, the list's name is the current element, so | json on it prints one value and is right.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="L"><gen type="text" value="Milk,Soy" repeat="0..2" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line each="L"><data>${{L | json}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: json-filter-on-a-list-joined-with-a-pipe
cases.description: A list joined with | cannot be split by json: at all — the pipe starts the next filter — so the warning asks for another separator.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen type="text" value="a,b" repeat="1..2" separator="|"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{P | json}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: json-filter-with-only-a-space-after-the-colon
cases.description: The argument is trimmed, so json: followed by a space names no separator either.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="L"><gen type="text" value="Milk,Soy" repeat="0..2" separator=";"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{L | json: }}</data></line></block></tdc>
